snippet.title: ASTRONEER - Megatech DLC Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
We’ve been dropping hints here and there, but now it’s official. We're getting a new supersized paid DLC expansion and free update for the base game!

Our second major DLC update for Astroneer is scheduled to be released in November of this year, and it brings big changes to the game! Unlock the ability to build massive Megastructure projects that will test your base building skills through the use of both new and existing technology. Harness the power of Megatech to take base building and automation to a whole new level!  

Learn more: https://blog.astroneer.space/p/astroneer-is-getting-new-dlc-major-free-update/

WISHLIST Now: 
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3884830/Astroneer_Megatech/
- Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/astroneer-megatech/9PJBL7ZK6K5B/0010

Astroneer is a space sandbox game with extensive crafting and creative tools for both single player and multiplayer co-op. Interact with strange new worlds in a unique and tactile way, molding the environment itself as if it were clay in your hands. Build your base, master resource management, automate your production lines, and more as you unravel the mysteries of the universe, alone or with friends.
